narrative: An open gathering of the foul papers on James's table, the sheet well on in the scene, oak-gall dry. Dick's hand is flat on the cloth beside the leaf, not on the writing. Your finger holds the two lines.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Held the two lines under a finger and did not revise them.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Left his hand flat beside the leaf.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in Sit upon the ground
